2.text: “Tegeka Abisirayeli uti ‘Nimugera mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni, icyo ni cyo gihugu muzahabwa ho gakondo nk'uko ingabano zacyo ziri.

3.text: Igice cy'ikusi cy'igihugu cyanyu kizagarukire ku butayu bwa Zini, gitegane na Edomu. Urugabano rwanyu rw'ikusi ruhere ku iherezo ry'Inyanja y'Umunyu, mu ruhande rwayo rw'iburasirazuba.

4.text: Maze ruzenguruke ruce iruhande rw'ikusi rw'ahaterera hajya muri Akurabimu, rujye i Zini rugarukire iruhande rw'ikusi rw'i Kadeshi Baruneya, maze rujye i Hasaradari rugende rugere muri Asimoni

5.text: ruvuye muri Asimoni, ruzenguruke rugere ku kagezi ka Egiputa, rugarukire ku Nyanja Nini.

6.text: “ ‘Urugabano rw'iburengerazuba ruzababere Inyanja Nini n'ikibaya cyayo, abe ari yo iba urugabano rwanyu rw'iburengerazuba.

7.text: “ ‘Uru abe ari rwo ruba urugabano rwanyu rw'ikasikazi, muhereye ku Nyanja Nini mushinge urugabano rugere ku musozi Hori.

8.text: Muhereye kuri uwo musozi, murushinge rugere ku rugabano rw'i Hamati rugarukire i Sedadi,

9.text: maze rujye i Zifuroni rugarukire i Hasarenani. Urwo abe ari rwo ruba urugabano rwanyu rw'ikasikazi.

10.text: “ ‘Kandi muzashinge urugabano rwanyu rw'iburasirazuba, muhereye i Hasarenani rugere i Shefamu.

11.text: Ruvuye i Shefamu rumanuke rugere i Ribula, iri iruhande rw'iburasirazuba rwa Ayini, rumanuke rugere ku ruhande rw'iburasirazuba rw'inyanja y'i Kinereti,

12.text: rumanuke rugere kuri Yorodani rugarukire ku Nyanja y'Umunyu.“ ‘Icyo abe ari cyo kiba igihugu cyanyu n'ingabano zacyo z'impande zose.’ ”

13.text: Mose ategeka Abisirayeli ati “Icyo ni cyo gihugu muzaheshwa ho gakondo n'ubufindo, icyo Uwiteka yategetse ko gihabwa imiryango cyenda, n'igice kingana n'igisigaye,

14.text: kuko umuryango w'Abarubeni nk'uko amazu ya ba sekuru ari, n'uw'Abagadi nk'uko amazu ya ba sekuru ari, n'igice gisigaye cy'umuryango wa Manase, bamaze guhabwa gakondo zabo.

15.text: Iyo miryango uko ari ibiri n'igice, yamaze guhabwa gakondo zayo hakuno ya Yorodani, mu ruhande rwayo rw'iburasirazuba.”

17.text: “Aya mazina ni yo y'abantu bazabagabanya igihugu ho gakondo: ni Eleyazari umutambyi na Yosuwa mwene Nuni.

18.text: Kandi muzatoranye umutware umwe umwe mu miryango yose, bagabanye igihugu ho gakondo.

19.text: Aya ni yo mazina y'abo bantu:Mu muryango wa Yuda mutoranye Kalebu mwene Yefune.

20.text: Mu muryango w'Abasimeyoni, Shemweli mwene Amihudi.

21.text: Mu muryango wa Benyamini, Eludadi mwene Kisiloni.

22.text: Mu muryango w'Abadani mutoranye umutware Buki mwene Yogili.

23.text: Mu Bayosefu mutoranye aba:Mu muryango w'Abamanase mutoranye umutware Haniyeli mwene Efodi.

24.text: Mu muryango w'Abefurayimu mutoranye umutware Kemuweli mwene Shifutani.

25.text: Mu muryango w'Abazebuluni mutoranye umutware Elisafani mwene Parunaki.

26.text: Mu muryango w'Abisakari mutoranye umutware Palutiyeli mwene Azani.

27.text: Mu muryango w'Abashēri mutoranye umutware Ahihudi mwene Shelomi.

28.text: Mu muryango w'Abanafutali mutoranye umutware, Pedaheli mwene Amihudi.”

29.text: Abo ni bo Uwiteka yategetse kugabanya Abisirayeli gakondo zabo zo mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni.
